changes.comment: Add quantity formatting for FieldRun values in text annotations: `"quantity"` and `"coordinate"` fields now render through the iTwin.js quantity pipeline instead of `toString()`. Register a per-iModel provider with `ElementDrivesTextAnnotation.registerFieldFormattingProvider`, which asynchronously pre-warms the `FormatterSpec`s you ask for (or `FieldFormattingSpecProvider.create` for an unregistered one — the constructor is private because a provider is only useful once warmed); `evaluateFields` and the txn field-update callbacks then format synchronously. Its `requirements` argument is mandatory — iTwin.js never walks the iModel to discover them. Build it from `FieldFormattingSpecProvider.collectSchemaFormattingRequirements` (every KindOfQuantity the schemas declare), `ElementDrivesTextAnnotation.collectFieldFormattingRequirements` (one TextBlock) and/or `ElementDrivesTextAnnotation.getFieldFormattingRequirements` (one FieldRun). Anything left unwarmed renders as a raw string and is reported on `FieldFormattingSpecProvider.misses`. Registrations are process-wide; pair each with `unregisterFieldFormattingProvider` when the iModel closes. A field whose property cannot be resolved, or whose format throws while being applied, is logged and rendered as `FieldRun.invalidContentIndicator` without abandoning the other fields of the same annotation.
